snippet.title: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
In this turned-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429050/Fretless__The_Wrath_of_Riffson/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
